title: Alias Schema
description: A human-friendly name for an object (Vol 1 §7; Vol 2 §19). Aliases are useful AND dangerous: an alias may change meaning over time. ALIAS != IDENTITY - so an alias MUST preserve its type, its resolution (as a reference, not an inlined identity), its ownership, and its resolution history. So alias, alias_type, resolves_to, owner, and resolution_history are required. Enforced by TOOLS/lore_validate.py Check 4.

alias_type.description: what kind of alias, e.g. role, environment, service-name.

resolves_to.description: object-ref id the alias currently resolves to (a reference; ALIAS != IDENTITY).

owner.description: object-ref id of who owns/controls the alias.

resolution_history.description: prior resolutions - because an alias may change meaning over time.
